name: Affections The
overview: Scripture reveals that affections should be supremely set upon God and His house, as exemplified by David's devotion in giving generously to the house of God (1 Chronicles 29:3). The statutes and commandments of the LORD are described as more desirable than gold and sweeter than honey, bringing joy and enlightenment to the heart and eyes (Psalms 19:8-10). The blessedness of making God the object of our affections is further emphasized in Deuteronomy 6:3, where obedience to God's commands leads to prosperity and increase. The delight found in the saints and the excellent reflects the proper setting of affections on God’s people (Psalms 16:3).
